node.title: DLI ambient-Q square-root route no-go
node.closure: explicit exact counterexample with independent replay
node.statement: The stronger ambient-Q route q^t P(Prim intersect ker Phi)<=sqrt(2n) is false. At (n,t,q,zeta)=(32,2,33409,7473), exact counts are Z0=384, C1=256, Z1=1696000, B0=174912. Thus K_amb=1116161281/33554432>8, while the true Haar ratio J_prim=33554432/18106125<8. A complete exact scan of all 189 high-cap primes 32768<q<65536 with q=1 mod 32 finds 56 ambient failures and zero Haar failures. Hence the actual marginal denominator is load-bearing; this does not falsify C2'' or its Haar square-root candidate.
node.attack_surface: Check primality and root order, raw Z0-C1 subtraction, both independent subset-sum censuses, exact ambient and Haar normalizations, complete high-cap prime coverage, and the explicit nonclaim for C2''.
node.falsifier: A mismatch in the q=33409 counts or ratios, failure of the ambient ratio to exceed 8, or failure of the true Haar ratio to remain below 8.
node.notes: This retires the scale-free ambient strengthening suggested by the fixed-weight Q bridge. The bridge remains true as a sufficient inequality, but its denominator floor is too lossy for the square-root constant.
